name: io.github.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents
title: Astro Agents - deterministic Western + Vedic astrology
description: Natal charts, transits, kundli, dashas, panchang, Gun Milan. JPL DE440, no LLM, hashed.

tools.resolve_birth_time: Astrology birth time to UTC conversion: convert a local birth date, time and place into exact Universal Time, with the historical time zone and UTC offset, Delta T, Local Mean Time and true solar time.
tools.planet_positions: Western astrology planet positions: the zodiac sign, longitude, latitude, speed and retrograde flag of the Sun, Moon, planets, lunar nodes and Lilith at any moment.
tools.aspects: Western astrology aspects: find the aspects between planets at a moment, or between longitudes you supply, with orb, exactness and applying or separating.
tools.natal_chart: Western astrology natal chart (birth chart, horoscope): planets in zodiac signs and houses, sun sign, moon sign and rising sign (ascendant), MC, aspects and a summary.
tools.transits: Western astrology transits: the transits to a natal chart at a moment, and the exact dates transiting aspects perfect over a window of up to a year.
tools.synastry: Western astrology synastry (relationship compatibility): compare two birth charts with cross-aspects, house overlays both ways and composite midpoints.
tools.nakshatras: Vedic astrology nakshatras: the sidereal nakshatra, pada and lord of every graha, plus the janma nakshatra with gana, yoni, nadi and varna.
tools.panchang: Vedic astrology panchang (Hindu calendar) for a day and place: tithi, vara, nakshatra, yoga and karana with their exact end times, plus sunrise and sunset.
tools.kundli: Vedic astrology birth chart (kundli, Jyotish horoscope, D1 and D9): lagna and the nine grahas with rashi, nakshatra, pada, house, dignity and combustion.
tools.kundli_full: Vedic astrology full kundli: all 16 Shodashavarga divisional charts, D1 to D60 (navamsa, dasamsa...), by Parashara's rules.
tools.vimshottari_dasha: Vedic astrology dasha periods: the Vimshottari maha, antar and pratyantar dashas with exact dates, the balance at birth and the periods running now.
tools.doshas: Vedic astrology doshas: check Manglik (Kuja), Kaal Sarp and Sade Sati / Dhaiya, each with the rule applied and the relevant dates.
tools.gun_milan: Vedic astrology kundli matching (horoscope matching, marriage compatibility): 36-point Ashtakoota Gun Milan with all 8 kootas and reasons, plus dosha and Manglik checks.
tools.vedic_report: Vedic astrology report in one call: kundli, Vimshottari dashas, doshas and the birth panchang.

trust: Positions from NASA/JPL DE440 (NASA/JPL), 1800-01-01..2200-01-01, via Skyfield: geocentric apparent, true equinox of date, IAU 2006/2000A.
Historical time zones resolved for you (IANA tz database, DST of the era, Local Mean Time); ambiguous or non-existent local times are flagged, never guessed.
Deterministic, no LLM: same input -> same bytes. Every response carries meta.input_sha256 and meta.result_sha256 (also as X-Input-SHA256 / X-Result-SHA256 headers); POST /v1/verify recomputes one.
Every convention is in the response: ayanamsa (name, true and mean value), house system, orbs, node type, dasha year length, dosha and koota rule sets.
Cross-validated against an independent engine (XALEN, Apache-2.0): ayanamsas agree to < 0.1", 15/16 divisional charts identically, all 11 house systems in structure.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.payment: Pay per call with **x402** (USDC on Base or Solana) or **MPP** (Tempo: OUSD or USDC.e). No account, no API key. First 3 calls free per client on the five $0.01-0.02 routes (any tool over MCP); every other route is always paid.
